findings.text: the codex section's cited evidence /tmp/s18-cut-pause/codex/ (codex.out, requests.jsonl) exists only on node-local /tmp of the probe's own allocation and nothing under the run directory duplicates it (probe/ holds codex_try.sh alone), so a later reader on another node, or after the allocation ends, cannot open the config-refusal message, the POST /v1/responses body shape or the five-attempt count the section rests on.

the log opens directly on the first result line and names no date, command or stub revision, so the ALL-PASS cannot be tied to the stub revision whose /v1/messages route bug was fixed mid-probe; the per-case result.json records the comparable context per case (argv, stub_cmd, port, claude_version) and this log records none of it.

item_verdicts.diff: there is no commit to read byte by byte, so I read the landed artefacts instead of the summary: probe/cases/*/result.json, probe/cases/*/requests.jsonl, probe/cases/*/bodies/NNNN.json and probe/selftest.py, and I recomputed the recorded sizes and hashes myself.
item_verdicts.done_when: the fence asks one row per stimulus carrying the client version, the stub command, whether the client retried, the retry-body comparison by message count and bytes, partial output discarded or duplicated, and turn completion; the report's table at :51-62 carries every column with the client version fixed for all rows at :42, each case's stub and client command stand one-to-one with the report's rows in the appendix at :216-239 (per row in the appendix rather than inside the cell), the codex reason is at :141-163, the SGLang mode citations at :85-139, and the viable-pattern verdict at :165-192.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to measure how Claude Code as clive runs it responds to a turn whose generation stream is cut or frozen, and the report answers it per stimulus at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/s18-cut-pause-probe.md:51-62 and states which pattern is viable for which client with the exact router wire form at :165-192.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20260925T120341809925-s18-cut-pause-probe/manifest.md; it records the four stimulus families and the ten measurements, names the selftest log and its ALL-PASS result, states the absence of any serving-state change, and reports as a follow-on that check-manifest resolves a declaration outside the repository to no scope root.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed dispatch fenced one path, the report; the manifest adds the run directory's probe/ tree, which the host line designates as where logs a later reader needs go; the worktree at /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/.reckon-worktrees/imas-ambix-0405601943d2/llac-s14-0925/s18-cut-pause-probe is clean at HEAD afe7aa086e00a79414e3902fd3b2a4055975c4a8, so nothing outside the two locations was written.

justifications.durability: probe/selftest.py:81-109 asserts each of the five stimulus wire forms over a raw socket with a condition that would redden it (a missing event: ping, a stop_reason on the close case, or a hold shorter than the requested hold), so the instrument check would fail if the stub regressed, but its log carries no revision header and its ping assertion runs at a 1 s interval over a 3 s hold rather than at the 15 s cadence the measured cases used.
justifications.evidence: I recomputed sha256 over every bodies/NNNN.json of five cases and every recorded size and hash matched result.json (19 bodies, identical hashes for the close retry and all eleven 529 attempts), the 529 control's eleven attempts with the 5,5,5,5,9,17,36,35,33,38 s cadence reproduce the table row, and the stub command, port and client version are recorded per case, but two evidence placements are defective as named in the findings.
justifications.fit: the report follows the sibling-report idiom (Method, Results, engine source, Verdict, Evidence, Follow-ons) and uses the plan's own vocabulary for the two patterns, and no repository source was touched so no naming rule applies to landed code; the only plan-labelled strings sit in probe-side artefacts outside version control (probe/stub.py:108 server_version).
justifications.goal_fidelity: /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/reports/s18-cut-pause-probe.md:165-192 answers the goal with a per-pattern wire form, but the measured client is the headless `claude -p` form (probe/run_case.py:127-128) while clive's own launcher execs the interactive client (imas_ambix/agent/clive.py:701), so the transfer from the headless mode to the interactive mode is disclosed in the report, not measured.
justifications.scope_discipline: every artefact the node wrote is the fenced report, the host-declared run-directory log location, or node-local scratch, its changed_paths list is complete, and the reviewed worktree is clean at afe7aa086e00a79414e3902fd3b2a4055975c4a8 with no repository file changed.
